ValidationRule.description: The "Reports To" field can be blank if ATG Alumni or ATG Alumni - Do Not Hire is selected. If the contact is a current ATG staff/consultant, this field cannot be left blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Record_Type_Name__c = "Staff" && ISBLANK(ReportsToId) = TRUE && NOT(CONTAINS(TEXT(ATG_Segment__c), "Alumni")) && TEXT(ATG_Title__c) != "COO" && TEXT(ATG_Title__c) != "CEO" && Account.Name != "Cognizant"
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Reports To cannot be blank for current ATG employees.
